prepared_ID_command.command:
# Run on the Pi, not the Mac. U1 identification only; no array read/write.
id_log=$(mktemp "$HOME/C8375-U1-ID-100kHz-XXXXXX.log") &&
sudo flashrom -V -p linux_spi:dev=/dev/spidev0.0,spispeed=100 -c MT25QU256 -o "$id_log"
prepared_ID_command.log_preservation: mktemp creates fresh mode0600 log in Pi home; stdout remains visible. No old evidence overwritten.
prepared_ID_command.validation: Local /bin/sh -n passed; exact MT25QU256 retained; linux_spi/MT25QU256 supported by already inventoried Pi build. Not a runtime/probe test.
